en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a coastal view with a fortified hilltop complex dominating the background, likely a citadel. Sailing ships are anchored in the calm harbor, and low waterfront buildings and trees line the shore in the foreground. The upper right corner bears printed text in French reading "Souvenir de Corfou." The image has a faded, early-photographic style typical of late‑19th or early‑20th‑century postcards, with some handwritten marks and a stamp impression near the bottom.
